JewelDesk Overview
Everything In One Place

Everything Your Jewellery Business Needs, In One Place

JewelDesk helps jewellery businesses manage their daily operations digitally — from inventory and sales to customers, reports, custom orders, and workshop team management.

⚠️ The Challenge With Traditional Jewellery Management

Jewellery retail is complex: fluctuating bullion rates, multi-karat purities, unrecorded old gold exchanges, karigar wastage discrepancies, and scattered paper registers create errors, revenue leakage, and customer trust issues.

✨ The JewelDesk Solution

A unified, intuitive platform designed specifically for the Indian jewellery industry. JewelDesk replaces messy paperwork with automated pricing, instant stock clarity, digital GST invoicing, and strict accountability.

🏛️
Centralized Management
Unify counter sales, stock vaults, customer credit, and karigar workshops in one place.
⚡
Faster Daily Operations
Auto-calculate metal rates, making charges, and taxes in seconds for rapid billing.
💎
Precision Inventory Visibility
Real-time clarity on gross weight, net weight, purity, stone weights, and piece counts.
👥
Organized Customer Records
Complete customer directory, purchase histories, PAN/GSTIN records, and pending dues.
⚖️
Easier Sales & Old Gold
Accurately assess customer old gold exchanges and deduct value directly from bills.
📊
Useful Business Reports
Instant analytics for Today, This Week, Month, and Custom Date Ranges with payment splits.
🧾
Digital Document & Invoices
Generate professional, GST-compliant PDF tax invoices and share via WhatsApp instantly.
🛡️
Better Team Control
Role-based permissions (Admin, Sales, Cashier, Manager) protect margins and settings.

JewelDesk Inventory Control
Vault & Counter Stock

Precision Inventory & Jewellery Stock Management

"Know what you have, where it is, and what is moving — without depending on scattered registers or spreadsheets."
✓
Three-Tier Weight Accounting Track Gross Weight, Stone Weight, and Net Metal Weight down to milligram precision (0.001g) on every individual piece.
✓
Multi-Karat & Metal Segregation Complete categorization for 24K, 22K, 18K, 14K Gold, 925 Sterling Silver, Platinum, and Bullion coins/bars.
✓
BIS Hallmark & 6-Digit HUID Tracking Record and search unique 6-character Hallmark Unique Identification codes for complete regulatory compliance.
✓
Flexible Making Charge Calculation Configure making charges either as per-gram rate (₹/g) or flat item amount (₹/pc) based on design complexity.
✓
Stock Movement & Audit Trail Every stock addition, counter display transfer, sale deduction, or customer return is logged with exact timestamp.
✓
Bulk Catalog CSV Import Easily transition existing spreadsheets into JewelDesk in minutes using our one-click CSV stock import utility.

JewelDesk Intelligence
Customers, Reports & Insights

Understand Your Business. Build Lasting Customer Trust.

"Use organized data and instant reports to gain clear visibility over showroom performance and customer credit."
👥
Customer Relationship Hub
  • Centralized Directory: Store customer mobile numbers, addresses, and family preferences in one digital book.
  • PAN & GSTIN Recording: Easily log customer PAN card details for high-value sales compliance over regulatory limits.
  • Purchase Histories: View every past sale, invoice copy, and date of purchase when customers return.
  • Credit & Dues Tracking: Clear ledger of outstanding balances with instant balance payment recording.
📊
Flexible Sales Reports
  • Today's Counter Summary: Review today's transactions, cash collected, and pending receipts at closing.
  • Periodical Trend Analysis: Filter reports by This Week, This Month, or Any Custom Date Range.
  • Category Velocity: Identify which categories (bridal sets, rings, chains) are generating top revenue.
  • Tender Breakdown: Exact breakdown of Cash vs. UPI vs. Card settlements for daily bank deposits.
📈
Real-Time Business Visibility
  • Live Cockpit Dashboard: Instant access to revenue, stock valuation, and receivables in a single view.
  • Low Stock Early Warning: Get alerted when popular design codes drop below minimum counter threshold.
  • Auditable Transaction Trails: Prevent discrepancies with clear tracking of every issued bill.
  • Clean Exportable Records: Export reporting datasets for monthly accounting reviews without friction.

JewelDesk Workshop & Staff
Custom Orders, Karigar & Security

Bespoke Orders, Workshop Tracking & Team Access

"Give your team the right access while keeping workshop operations and custom jewellery orders organized."
✨
Custom Jewellery Orders
  • Bespoke Client Requests: Record specific customer requirements, metal preference, target purity, and target weight.
  • Design Reference Notes: Store detailed design instructions and customer specifications directly on the order.
  • Delivery Commitments: Set target delivery dates and track customer order status in real time.
  • Order Progression: Simple pipeline tracking from Order Placed → In Workshop → Ready for Pickup → Delivered.
🔨
Karigar & Workshop Tracking
1. Metal Issue Weigh and log raw gold or silver given to specific artisans.
2. Finished Goods Intake Weigh finished jewellery piece upon return.
3. Wastage Reconciliation Calculate returned scrap and exact wastage (ghat) percentage.
4. Making Settlement Track making charges earned, advances given, and balance dues.
🛡️
Role-Based Team Access

Safeguard profit margins, bullion price adjustments, and company settings by granting staff only the permissions they require.

Predefined Business Roles:
Admin Manager Sales Executive Cashier Inventory Manager Accountant Support
  • Granular Control: View, Add, Edit, Delete permissions per module.
  • Branch Security: Assign staff members to specific showroom locations.
